title: Plugin call
source: An operator interface learns which Plugins Core has, runs a Plugin action, asks for the Plugin list again, and sees a call that fails.

steps.why: Core pushes one plugin.describe per Plugin with the Asset descriptions: Plugin DEM offers ground_elevation.
The operator asks DEM for the ground elevation at a point.
One result item, naming the call by reply_from and reply_to. Plugins are inside Core, so from is CORE.
The reply comes last and marks the end: the call finished.
Later the operator asks again which Plugins Core has.
then the reply that ends the answer.
The operator asks for a point the Plugin's elevation data does not cover.
The Plugin ran and broke, so the reply is failed with an explanation, not refused. Refused would mean Core never ran the call.
